# Walkie Talkie Bot — A Walkie Talkie for Claude

> Voice-first AI assistant for Claude Code — use as a Claude Code plugin (30 MCP tools + 5 skills, offline SQLite) or full server (web UI, 6 retro themes, voice, background jobs).

## Quick Start

  Install: npx walkietalkiebot   (run it from the project directory Claude should work in)
  Requires: Node.js >= 20; Claude Code CLI installed and logged in (`claude` on PATH); Chrome or Edge for voice
  Repository: https://github.com/bengillin/walkietalkiebot
  npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/walkietalkiebot
  Website: https://walkietalkie.bot
  Version: 0.3.8
  License: MIT

## MCP Installation

  Register the MCP server for all projects (user scope):
    claude mcp add --scope user wtb -- npx -y -p walkietalkiebot wtb-mcp

  Or add it to a project's .mcp.json:
  {
    "mcpServers": {
      "wtb": {
        "command": "npx",
        "args": ["-y", "-p", "walkietalkiebot", "wtb-mcp"]
      }
    }
  }

  WARNING: do not use `npx wtb-mcp`. The `wtb-mcp` package on npm is an unrelated third party's
  package; the Talkie binary ships inside `walkietalkiebot`, hence `-p walkietalkiebot`.

  The MCP server provides 30 tools (15 work offline via direct SQLite, 15 require the Walkie Talkie Bot server).
  The 5 skills ship with the Claude Code plugin in the repository (skills/).

## Security

  Claude Code runs with --permission-mode bypassPermissions in the server's working directory, so
  access to the API is equivalent to shell access on the host.
  - The server binds to 127.0.0.1 by default. WTB_HOST changes it; a non-loopback host requires WTB_AUTH_TOKEN
    or the server refuses to start.
  - Cross-origin requests are rejected (no wildcard CORS) and the Host header is validated.
  - With WTB_AUTH_TOKEN set, send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every /api request.

## Configuration (environment variables)

  WTB_PORT            default 5173        Server port (also used by the MCP server to find it)
  WTB_HOST            default 127.0.0.1   Bind address; non-loopback requires WTB_AUTH_TOKEN
  WTB_DIR             default ~/.wtb      Data dir: database, modes, logs, pid, TLS certs
  WTB_AUTH_TOKEN      default unset       Shared-secret bearer token for /api/*
  WTB_LOG_LEVEL       default info        debug | info | warn | error | silent
  WTB_TELEMETRY       default off         Set to 1 to opt in to MCP telemetry (tool name, category,
                                          success flag to PostHog; nothing from conversations)
  WTB_MAX_BODY_BYTES  default 52428800    Max request body (50 MB)

## Documentation

  - Getting Started: https://walkietalkie.bot/docs/getting-started.html
  - Features: https://walkietalkie.bot/docs/features.html
  - API Reference: https://walkietalkie.bot/docs/api.html

  - Theme System: https://walkietalkie.bot/docs/themes.html

## Architecture

  Frontend: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Zustand
  Server: Node.js, Hono, better-sqlite3 (WAL mode)
  MCP: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk (stdio transport)
  Voice: Web Speech API (browser-native STT/TTS)
  Database: SQLite at ~/.wtb/wtb.db

## Features

  - Voice input: Push-to-talk, wake word ("Hey Talkie"), continuous listening, trigger word ("over")
  - 6 retro themes: TalkBoy, Bubble, Dial-Up, Finder, Guestbook, 1984 (70+ CSS custom properties each)
  - Cassette tape UI: Conversations stored as illustrated cassette tapes with spinning reels
  - Claude Code CLI integration (the only backend; no API-key mode): runs claude -p with full tool access, persistent per-conversation sessions, real-time activity feed
  - Modes: Voice, Pair, Architect, Code Review, Debug, plus custom modes from ~/.wtb/modes/*.json
  - Plans system: Auto-detect plans in Claude responses, status workflow (draft/approved/in_progress/completed/archived)
  - Liner notes: Per-conversation markdown notes
  - Full-text search: FTS5-powered, Cmd+K global search
  - Context linking: Use past conversations as context for new messages
  - Image handling: Drag-drop, Claude vision analysis, media library
  - Background jobs: Up to 3 concurrent async jobs with SSE streaming
  - Export: Markdown and JSON
  - Keyboard shortcuts: Spacebar push-to-talk, Cmd+K search, Cmd+E export

## MCP Server (30 Tools)

  Data Tools (15, work offline via direct SQLite):

  Conversations:
  - list_conversations: List all saved conversations with pagination
  - get_conversation: Get full conversation with messages, images, and activities
  - create_conversation: Create a new conversation (cassette tape)
  - rename_conversation: Rename an existing conversation
  - delete_conversation: Delete a conversation permanently

  Search:
  - search_conversations: Full-text search across all conversations (FTS5)

  Messages:
  - add_message: Add a message to an existing conversation

  Plans:
  - list_plans: List all plans with status workflow
  - get_plan: Get a plan by ID with full content
  - create_plan: Create a new plan (draft/approved/in_progress/completed/archived)
  - update_plan: Update plan title, content, or status
  - delete_plan: Delete a plan permanently

  Liner Notes:
  - get_liner_notes: Get per-conversation markdown notes
  - set_liner_notes: Set or clear liner notes for a conversation

  Export:
  - export_conversation: Export conversation as markdown or JSON

  Server Tools (15, require Walkie Talkie Bot server):

  Core:
  - launch_wtb: Start server and open browser
  - get_wtb_status: Check running status and avatar state

  Session:
  - get_claude_session: Get connected session ID
  - set_claude_session: Connect to Claude Code session
  - disconnect_claude_session: Disconnect session

  IPC:
  - get_pending_message: Poll for user messages (IPC mode)
  - respond_to_wtb: Send response to user (IPC mode)
  - get_transcript: Get latest voice transcript
  - get_conversation_history: Get current conversation messages

  State:
  - update_wtb_state: Set avatar state, transcript

  Media:
  - analyze_image: Claude vision analysis of images
  - open_url: Open URL in default browser

  Jobs:
  - create_wtb_job: Create background async job
  - get_wtb_job: Get job status and result
  - list_wtb_jobs: List jobs, optionally filtered by status

## Skills (5)

  - save-conversation: Save the current Claude Code conversation as a cassette tape
  - search-tapes: Search across all saved conversations using full-text search
  - manage-plans: Create, update, and track plans with status workflow
  - launch-voice: Launch the Walkie Talkie Bot voice interface in a browser
  - export-tape: Export a conversation as markdown or JSON

## REST API

  Base URL: http://localhost:5173/api
  40+ endpoints covering:
  - Status & Health: GET /api/status, GET /api/integrations
  - Conversations: CRUD, messages, liner notes, images (9 endpoints)
  - Plans: CRUD with status workflow (5 endpoints)
  - Jobs: create, orchestrate, list, get, cancel, SSE events (6 endpoints)
  - Search: GET /api/search (FTS5 full-text)
  - IPC: pending, respond, send (3 endpoints)
  - Sessions: get, set, delete (3 endpoints)
  - Claude Code: POST /api/claude-code (SSE streaming)
  - Media: analyze-image-cc, open-url

  Full reference: https://walkietalkie.bot/docs/api.html

## CLI Commands

  wtb-server start [-f]    Start server (background or -f foreground)
  wtb-server stop          Stop the server
  wtb-server restart       Restart
  wtb-server status        Show status (running, port, DB)
  wtb-server logs [-f]     View logs (-f to follow)
  wtb-server install       Install as macOS launchd daemon
  wtb-server uninstall     Remove launchd daemon

## Database Schema (v6)

  Tables: conversations, messages, message_images, activities, plans, jobs, job_events, messages_fts, schema_version
  Location: ~/.wtb/wtb.db, or $WTB_DIR/wtb.db (SQLite WAL mode)
